card.title: Not Why We Drifted
card.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've brought the picnic basket. Same sandwiches as our last afternoon here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The afternoon you said we needed space?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've got more space under that tree. Shall we move the blanket?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving won't stop me asking why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay here. You always had strong views about mustard; tell me if I've finally got it right.

mechanism: A uses picnic logistics and familiar preferences to prevent discussion of why they asked for distance.
confusable: Unlike simply reminiscing, each diversion must respond to B nearing the cause of the changed relationship.
comparison: D86-a turns space into blanket location then mustard; D86-b turns separation talk into video segments and a family mishap.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
